items.headline: SEC Network's Chris Doering sets Week 8 predictions
items.description: Doering selects his expected winners of Week 8 after several stuns in Week 7, and emphasizes a bold belief in South Carolina.

items.headline: Jason Campbell discusses Auburn's growing chemistry
items.description: Auburn great Jason Campbell joins SEC This Morning to discuss how Tigers alumni support Alex Golesh and how Auburn can carry its momentum into a matchup with No. 18 LSU.

items.headline: Connelly previews Week 8: SEC elimination games, tests for top 2 and more
items.description: Ole Miss, Tennessee and LSU face road challenges, while Miami and BYU try to avoid the upset bug.

items.headline: Can Week 8 up the ante again with more upsets and drama?
items.description: With plenty of SEC drama last week, could Week 8 bring even more chaos?

items.headline: Auburn's Alex McPherson tells story of his battle with Crohn's disease
items.description: McPherson discusses how his toughness was tested off the gridiron and how relieved he was to return to the field after so much time away.

items.headline: LSU standout TE Trey'Dez Green poised for return vs. Auburn
items.description: Trey'Dez Green, widely regarded as one of the top tight ends in the country, is poised to return Saturday after missing the past three games with a leg injury.
